scientific_integrity: Explicit all-n proof with analytic Gaussian limit; finite brute checks n=3..9 and polynomial coefficient checks n=3..150; novelty qualified by strong existing structural descriptions.
scientific_limitations: Counts only initially primitive two-cycles on labelled simple C_n, n>=3; no basin sizes or other periods; finite tests corroborate the analytic all-size proof. Previously known ring-period-two building blocks are attributed to Dall'Asta (2006). Historical priority uncertainty remains.
title: Exact chip-mass polynomial and Gaussian law for primitive two-cycles on finite rings
